inspection_basis: Actual view_image tool inspections followed by decoded RGBA identity comparison for post-build delivery rerenders. Record time is separate from pixel-view clock observation.
observations: Actual eight exact-GLB frames inspected. One coherent matrix supports a sloping high mass and lowered shoulder, with a tapering front fracture and basal chip. Front/rear/sides/top show dark thin lenses of unequal lengths; clay proves shallow physical lenticular relief rather than painted spots. The final quiet planes remain more geometric and smoother than the rough concept, and fiamme are represented by weathered depressed relief rather than exact pumice texture. No strict field specimen or locality claim. Independent craft and factual approval remain pending.
